meta.title: The Deaf Gap
meta.grain: one row per Deaf people group
meta.measured: 150 sign languages · 234 people groups · 84,159,050 people. 136 languages / 183 groups / 55,199,840 people with NOTHING found.
meta.bridge_rule: A sign language is bridged ONLY by another sign language. Text and audio in a spoken language do not reach a Deaf community.
meta.compounding_problem: 40 of these languages carry PRIVATE-USE (qaa-qtz) codes outside ISO 639-3. No resource pool indexes a private-use code, so those groups cannot be matched to a resource even if one exists.
meta.what_is_unchecked: Deaf Bible Society and DOOR International, both key-gated. The open catalogues are exhausted: the JESUS Film lists 14 sign-language entries across 13 ISO codes and every one is already here, and Faith Comes By Hearing carries none.
meta.source: data/tables/people-group-pins.json — the same index the map draws, so the two cannot disagree.
